message: Fixed. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treated `percent` as a fraction, so a 50% refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100: `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`. `npm test` passes all 20 tests, including the partial-refund ones.
